title: grindelia camporum var. interioris
intro: Grindelia camporum var. interioris, commonly known as Interior Grindelia, is a plant species in the sunflower family, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, skin conditions, and inflammation, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Interior Grindelia include reducing inflammation, acting as an expectorant, and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
